engine.notes: Portland is unusually rich: two nonprofit theatres (Curious, Kickstand), the oldest continuously running ComedySportz franchise, Deep End's Sound Improv school and Funhouse Lounge. Beaverton has no improv organisation of its own; The Siren Theater on N Mississippi lists only stand-up and parody for late 2025 and no classes since 2023, and Portland Center Stage's beginner improv page still shows 20

entries.name: Curious Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Nonprofit comedy theatre founded 2008 with the Showdown improv cage match every Friday and Saturday, ensembles like The Gauntlet and Rogue, and improv, musical improv, sketch, stand-up and youth classes with a free intro and a BIPOC track.
entries.schedule: Showdown every Friday and Saturday 7:30pm; Level 1, free intro and BIPOC Level 1 classes
signals: Founded 2008, nonprofit
5225 NE MLK Jr Blvd, two stages
Showdown improv cage match Fridays and Saturdays
Free intro class and BIPOC Level 1
Around 25 instructors and teaching artists
Ensembles such as The Gauntlet, Rogue and Dropped Notes
entries.reasons: Eighteen years, a building with two stages and weekly flagship shows; class pages list tracks but the fetchable site did not expose dated sessions.

entries.name: Portland Comedy Theater (CSz Portland)
entries.summary: Home of ComedySportz Portland, playing every weekend since 1993 at 535 NW 16th Avenue, alongside late-night and themed improv, stand-up and sketch, with Improv 101, youth classes and summer camps.
entries.schedule: ComedySportz every weekend; late-night shows such as Naughty Bits and Spill the Tea; Improv 101 and youth classes
signals: ComedySportz here since April 1993, now in its 32nd season
535 NW 16th Avenue
Has not missed a weekend since May 1993
Improv 101, stand-up, youth classes and camps
Separate adult, teen and family classes
entries.reasons: Thirty-three unbroken years of weekend shows in its own theatre; the class side is broad but its levels and dates are not visible on the site.

entries.name: Kickstand Comedy
entries.summary: Nonprofit long-form improv theatre in the former Brody Theater building on SE Hawthorne, with a five-level curriculum plus Advanced Study, class shows from Level 3, improv jams open to anyone and a BIPOC pay-what-you-will track.
entries.schedule: Six-week levels, 2.5 hours a week; next session starts October 20; improv jams on the calendar
signals: Took over the former Brody Theater space after an April 2019 Kickstarter
1006 SE Hawthorne Blvd
Five levels plus Advanced Study, six weeks each
Class shows from Level 3; the Harold taught at Level 5
BIPOC program free or pay-what-you-will through Level 3
Named one of eight great improv theaters by Paste
entries.reasons: The city's most complete long-form curriculum in a room of its own with jams, docked for a 2019 start and show listings the site did not render.

entries.name: Deep End Theater
entries.summary: Improv theatre on SE Market St led by Domeka Parker, teaching Sound Improv in three levelled six-week classes, with the Skinny Dip open-stage jam on first and third Mondays and improvised plays running through autumn 2026.
entries.schedule: Skinny Dip 1st and 3rd Mondays 7pm ($5, free to play); Thirsty Oct 16-31; classes Nov 3-Dec 19, 2026, $220
signals: 1129 SE Market St
Intro, Foundations and Ensemble six-week classes at $220
Skinny Dip improv jam and variety show twice monthly
Free workshop October 25, 2026
Teen and youth programmes
Part of the Four Corners Collective with Canadian companies
entries.reasons: A smaller house with the most legible current calendar in Portland, dated classes and a twice-monthly jam, held back by scale and a short history.

entries.name: Funhouse Lounge
entries.summary: Fringe theatre and bar that mixes improv into a packed comedy calendar, with an Improv 101 weekend, Roast Battle Portland, a Friday Midnight Mic and parody musicals.
entries.schedule: Improv 101 Oct 17-18, 2026; Midnight Mic every Friday; roast battles most Thursdays
signals: 2432 SE 11th Ave
Improv 101 weekend workshop
Weekly Midnight Mic
Calendar dated September to November 2026
entries.reasons: A long-standing venue with a current calendar, but improv is one strand among many and the teaching is a single weekend course.
